## S3 storage at a glance
Size, monthly storage cost and estimated savings from each bucket's **latest S3 Inventory snapshot**. Costs are S3 storage **list prices** (the `s3_storage_class_pricing` seed), not invoiced spend. Every number comes from the `s3_storage_metrics` metric view. Query it directly or ask Genie for anything not shown here. Check **Pipeline health** before acting on a number.

frame.title: Noncurrent share
frame.description: Bytes kept only by bucket versioning

lines: Versioning status is **inferred** from the inventory's version fields. `unknown` means the inventory lists current versions only; turn on *Include all versions* to classify it. On a versioned bucket, every object Delta VACUUM or OPTIMIZE deletes stays as a **noncurrent version** until a lifecycle rule expires it.

frame.title: Storage by table activity
frame.description: inactive = no read or write in table lineage within the activity window

frame.title: Monthly cost by ownership
frame.description: unity_catalog = a UC table owns it; inferred_delta_log = an unregistered Delta table; untracked = no table

lines: Each byte counts toward **at most one** opportunity, so savings add up across rows. Estimates cover storage list price only; they exclude request, transition and early-deletion charges.

frame.title: Where to act (filter Opportunity above; "none" = nothing to do)

lines: Slice by any dimension in `s3_storage_metrics`: top-level prefix, storage class, object age, or object size.

frame.title: Objects by size band
frame.description: Many objects under 128 KB means small files: slow scans and minimum-size billing

lines:
## Is the inventory feed healthy?
From the `s3_inventory_pipeline_health_metrics` metric view, with one row per bucket per inventory snapshot. **Stale buckets** and the *hours since* tiles use the current clock. Everything else is checked per snapshot. Health status shows the first failing check: `missing_ingested_at`, `malformed_rows`, `late_ingest`, `delivery_gap`, `volume_shift`, `unpriced_storage`. Sample data (`inventory_source = sample`) is always stale.

frame.description: Latest snapshot older than the gap threshold
